location: Happy Valley, Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong

main_turf.surface: Turf (Zoysia and Bermuda grass mixture on high-drainage sand base)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). World-famous urban amphitheatre racecourse operated by the Hong Kong Jockey Club (HKJC), hosting Wednesday night racing. Features a tight 1,450m oval with tight cambered turns and a short 310m home straight. Pure front-runners ('E' style) and rail-running pressers ('P' style) hold a powerful bias across all sprint distances. The tight turns penalize wide-running horses heavily.
main_turf.post_bias: SEVERE INSIDE BARRIER BIAS IN SPRINTS: Barrier draws 1 through 4 hold a decisive advantage over 1000m and 1200m. Over 1000m, wide draws (9-12) suffer a massive ground-loss penalty going into the first bend. On C and C+3 rail configurations, the track narrows, making outer draws almost impossible unless possessing elite gate speed.

handicapping_angles.rail_configuration_bias_a_vs_c3: HKJC operates 4 main rail positions: A Course (True), B Course (+3m-4m), C Course (+6.5m), and C+3 Course (+9m). On C and C+3 courses, the rail is moved out, narrowing the track and creating a extreme front-runner ('E' style) and inside rail lock bias. On A Course, swoopers ('S' style) have a slightly fairer run in the 310m straight.
handicapping_angles.1000m_city_dash_barrier_lock: The 1000m start has a very short run to the first turn. Inside draws (1-3) holding the rail win over 55% of 1000m races. Heavily downgrade horses drawn 9-12 unless they possess elite early gate acceleration.
handicapping_angles.1650m_valley_mile_tactical_positioning: The 1650m Valley Mile starts right in front of the grandstand, passing the winning post twice. Horses must secure a forward position ('E' or 'P') before the first bend. Horses caught 3-wide without cover on the first turn burn out before reaching the stretch.
handicapping_angles.king_of_the_valley_trainers: Caspar Fownes ('King of the Valley'), Ricky Yiu, John Size, Frankie Lor, Danny Shum, and Francis Lui specialize at Happy Valley. Grant a trainer specialty bonus (+2.5 pts) for Fownes and Yiu runners at Wednesday night meetings.
handicapping_angles.top_hkjc_jockeys_ground_saving: Elite HKJC jockeys (Zac Purton, Hugh Bowman, Karis Teetan, Vincent Ho, Andrea Atzeni, Brenton Avdulla) excel at saving ground along the inside fence on tight turns. Purton and Bowman riders hold an exceptional win rate at Happy Valley.
handicapping_angles.sha_tin_to_happy_valley_class_shift: Horses transferring from wide, sweeping Sha Tin to tight Happy Valley often improve dramatically if they possess quick gate speed ('E' or 'P' style). Big-striding closers from Sha Tin frequently struggle around Happy Valley's tight turns.
handicapping_angles.longines_ijc_december_feature: The Longines International Jockeys' Championship (IJC, December) features 12 of the world's top international jockeys. Class ratings elevate to international Grade 1 level.
handicapping_angles.hkjc_class_hierarchy: Class 1 (90-115+ rating), Class 2 (80-100), Class 3 (60-80 - ultra-competitive), Class 4 (40-60 - main volume), Class 5 (0-40 - lowest class).

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 1 (Hong Kong Jockey Club Premier Headquarters)
